title: Lecturer on Restorative Dentistry and Biomaterials Sciences
bio: Dr. Benjamin Costa graduated from Tufts School of Dental Medicine in 2015. He spent a year in private practice in San Diego, CA, before joining the Harvard University Health Services Dental Clinic, where he practiced from 2016 to 2020. Costa is passionate about advancing digital dentistry, which offers more efficient, affordable, and high-quality dental care. He is dedicated to highlighting the connection between oral and systemic health to improve dental health through better nutrition and lifestyle choices.
